title: Bad Purchase
text: Bad Purchase. When I read someone's review BEFORE I ordered this item, it said the glass pot easily spilled it's contents.  To be honest I thought maybe the purchaser was all thumbs..........well, not so.  I ordered this coffee pot and the glass pot design is really a poor design overall.  It does spill even if you're super careful so there's a lot of waste.  I was fortunate to find a coffee pot that fit the bill perfectly from Mr. Coffee AND FOR THE SAME PRICE I got a more features.  Bottom line......don't waste your money on this one.

product_metadata.title: Elite Cuisine EHC-2022 4 Cup Coffee Maker with Pause and Serve, Black
features: Semi-transparent water reservoir holds up to 4 cup capacity with water level indicator
4 cup glass coffee carafe is dishwasher safe
Pause 'N Serve function and On/Off switch
Swing out filter compartment with re-usable and washable built-in filter
description: Start your day off right with the Elite Cuisine 4-Cup Coffeemaker. Its compact design is great for home, school or office. Brews up to 4 cups of coffee and has a conveniently marked carafe and water reservoir. Features a built-in Pause ‘N Serve system that allows you to sneak a cup of coffee while still brewing. The built-in removable and washable filter saves money and eliminates waste from disposable filters and makes clean-up a cinch. Also has an On/Off switch and power indicator light.
